<thought>Based on the mapped reaction for template 74054, the left‑hand side of the reaction (the reactants) are the possible precursors. Removing the atom‑mapping annotations gives the two precursor SMILES: “CC(=O)c1c(O)ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c1” and “O=C1CCC1”. Hence the only possible precursor combination is these two molecules.</thought>
<final_answer>[["CC(=O)c1c(O)ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c1", "O=C1CCC1"]]</final_answer>
